pending_commit.commit_message: BACKPORT: usb: core: Add "quirks" parameter for usbcore Trying quirks in usbcore needs to rebuild the driver or the entire kernel if it's builtin. It can save a lot of time if usbcore has similar ability like "usbhid.quirks=" and "usb-storage.quirks=". Rename the original quirk detection function to "static" as we introduce this new "dynamic" function. Now users can use "usbcore.quirks=" as short term workaround before the next kernel release. Also, the quirk parameter can XOR the builtin quirks for debugging purpose. This is inspired by usbhid and usb-storage. BUG=b:112774171 BRANCH=master TEST=build and boot system. add usbcore.quirks into cmdline. Signed-off-by: Kai-Heng Feng <kai.heng.feng@canonical.com> Signed-off-by: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org> Signed-off-by: Jongpil Jung <jongpil19.jung@samsung.com> (cherry picked from commit 027bd6cafd9a1e3a109b5e5682c85ac84e804a8d) Signed-off-by: Harry Pan <harry.pan@intel.com> Conflicts: Documentation/admin-guide/kernel-parameters.txt (The file has been split from Documentation/admin-guide/kernel-parameters.txt in upstream, manually backport the document onto old file to skip dependency) Change-Id: Idd6e69f47982ea3e6ae719d7ad2e8a99e1f26e24 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1219206 Commit-Ready: Rajat Jain <rajatja@chromium.org> Tested-by: Rajat Jain <rajatja@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Rajat Jain <rajatja@chromium.org>

UPSTREAM: usb: core: Copy parameter string correctly and remove superfluous null check strsep() slices string, so the string gets copied by param_set_copystring() at the end of quirks_param_set() is not the original value. Fix that by calling param_set_copystring() earlier. The null check for val is unnecessary, the caller of quirks_param_set() does not pass null string. Remove the superfluous null check. This is found by Smatch. BUG=b:112774171 BRANCH=master TEST=build and boot system. add usbcore.quirks into cmdline. FROMLIST: usb: core: safely deal with the dynamic quirk lists Applying dynamic usbcore quirks in early booting when the slab is not yet ready would cause kernel panic of null pointer dereference because the quirk_count has been counted as 1 while the quirk_list was failed to allocate. i.e., [ 1.044970] BUG: unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference at (null) [ 1.044995] IP: [<ffffffffb0953ec7>] usb_detect_quirks+0x88/0xd1 [ 1.045016] PGD 0 [ 1.045026] Oops: 0000 [#1] PREEMPT SMP [ 1.046986] gsmi: Log Shutdown Reason 0x03 [ 1.046995] Modules linked in: [ 1.047008] CPU: 0 PID: 81 Comm: kworker/0:3 Not tainted 4.4.154 #28 [ 1.047016] Hardware name: Google Coral/Coral, BIOS Google_Coral.10068.27.0 12/04/2017 [ 1.047028] Workqueue: usb_hub_wq hub_event [ 1.047037] task: ffff88017a321c80 task.stack: ffff88017a384000 [ 1.047044] RIP: 0010:[<ffffffffb0953ec7>] [<ffffffffb0953ec7>] usb_detect_quirks+0x88/0xd1 To tackle this odd, let's balance the quirk_count to 0 when the kcalloc call fails, and defer the quirk setting into a lower level callback which ensures that the kernel memory management has been initialized. BUG=b:112774171 BRANCH=master TEST=build and boot system. add usbcore.quirks into cmdline. Fixes: 027bd6cafd9a ("usb: core: Add "quirks" parameter for usbcore") (am from https://lore.kernel.org/patchwork/patch/985988/mbox/)) Signed-off-by: Harry Pan <harry.pan@intel.com> Acked-by: Kai-Heng Feng <kai.heng.feng@canonical.com> Change-Id: I2364225d3050878f4b2acb9eb1c6bc5eb7012580 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1224190 Commit-Ready: Rajat Jain <rajatja@chromium.org> Tested-by: Rajat Jain <rajatja@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Rajat Jain <rajatja@chromium.org>

CHROMIUM: media: rockchip-vpu: add jpeg encoder for rk3399 The RK3399 jpeg encoder can encode YUV/RGB to JPEG, but the data frame does not contain headers. This driver uses V4L2_PIX_FMT_JPEG_RAW as capture format, userspace shall take care of adding necessary headers. Meanwhile, userspace is responsible for setting the lumination and chromination quantization tables. BUG=b:77835279 TEST=Encode YUV data to JPEG with different quality.
